title: Packaged gate diff styles
description: Set FARMSLOT_REVIEW_RUN_ID and FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT for an authenticated production test client showing a real review gate. Reads the frozen file diff through git.diff and checks split/unified rendering without resolving or publishing the review.

gate-diff.intent: The gate displays the gateway's real diff and both split panes share a row, with the modified code visible to the right. Unified mode retains code lines.
